m = marks.ravel()
print(np.where(m >= 60, 'P', 'F'))
print(np.select([m >= 85, m >= 70, m >= 60], ['A', 'B', 'C'], default='F'))

print(np.where(marks >= 90, marks, 0))    # keep shape, zero the rest
